builder_role: user-authorized direct Builder simulation through public platform APIs
expected: A query about filtered finance content must refuse when the caller has only operations access.
An unsupported cafeteria query must refuse instead of borrowing a weakly related public emergency page.
An authorized payroll query must rank the payroll source above a public page that only shares the word emergency.
A reviewer rejection must deliver no source citation while the pre-review retrieval evidence still identifies the authorized payroll source.

actual.verifier_issue: The public verifier incorrectly required a delivered citation even though reviewer rejection intentionally clears citations.

missing_contract: The host-neutral retrieval capability needs relevance scoring that discounts non-discriminative query terms before lexical ranking, so shared stop words cannot create an answer and a specific authorized source outranks a generic public source. The acceptance layer must distinguish pre-review retrieval evidence from post-rejection delivery citations.
